correctness.rationale: The free involution permits an exact orbit-barycenter fixed-complex model. Direct Hamming-distance comparison gives adjacency if and only if colors differ and residual cube distance is at most one. Triangle-freeness of the residual cube shows the complex is glued from cross-polytope three-sphere boundaries, with intersections exactly its full vertex tetrahedra. Contracting the disjoint tetrahedra and a spanning tree of connecting arcs yields the stated wedge by genuine homotopy equivalences of CW complexes. Below the first-admissible scale three every involution orbit is forbidden. The standalone verifier independently confirms pair compatibility and small-dimensional maximal cliques, f-vectors and mod-two homology; those finite checks are not used as infinite or integral proofs.

value.rationale: The involution flipping exactly three bits is a natural group action at its first admissible metric scale. Its entire geometric fixed-point homotopy type is classified uniformly for all ambient cube dimensions, with distinct freely generated degree-one and degree-three topology when enough coordinates remain. The cross-polytope blocks and cube graph incidence give a structural mechanism behind two exponentially growing homology ranks, an invariant that ambient homology/representation computations cannot recover. This is not a parameter-renaming deduction or arbitrary finite slice.
